Namaste! I'm **Masala Mitra**, your table-side friend at NASH Dhabha & Bakes.
Say **hi** to start. I'll ask your mood and suggest dishes from our menu. You can type or tap the mic to speak.
What are your timings?
We are open every day from 7:00 AM to 11:30 PM. The kitchen serves meals from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM, and the bakery counter opens at 7:00 AM.
do you have jain food?

Jain preparation (no onion, garlic or root vegetables) is possible for most gravies on request. Add it as a chef note. Bakes contain wheat and dairy; kulfi and desserts may contain nuts. Tell the chef about any allergy in the chef note.
how much GST do you charge
Bills include 5% GST, split as 2.5% CGST and 2.5% SGST. Totals are rounded to the nearest rupee.
is the black forest cake eggless
**Black Forest Cake (500 g)** is eggless. Eggless whole cake with cherries and cream.
